plan.english: Grandmother, I found honey in the hollow of an oak. Did you take it? I took a little, and I ate it up. It was sweeter than milk. Show me the tree. Let us carry the honey home. Mead comes forth from honey. Will you give me mead? Mead is for men. For you there is milk!

plan.english: Of-Goodly-Fame, sing us a song! Which song do you want? Sing the song of Dawn, the daughter of the Sky. I will sing it, and you will grind the grain. I do not know the quern. Then listen, and learn! Dawn has become bright; the daughter of the Sky is coming. That is beautiful.

plan.english: Wife, evening has come. It is getting dark. Tell me. What shall we do at dawn? You will drive the horses to the spring. Our daughter will carry water. Our son will fasten the fence. What will you do? I will weave, and I will grind wheat with your mother. Now let us sleep. May the gods guard our house in the night. Are you sleeping?
